Name: Dazing Blast
Description: A wave of forceful energy leaves your palms and travels towards your target. Make a spell attack against a creature. If you hit the target, they take 2d6 force damage and must succeed at a Constitution saving throw or become dazed until the end of their next turn.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot above 2nd.
